evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

cases.name: Data deal without cyber
cases.query: Review the insurance requirements in this agreement. The vendor will process our customer PII and connect to our systems; we're the customer.
files: insurance clause requiring only $1M CGL and workers' comp; the indemnity covers data breaches uncapped; no cyber/E&O requirement; COI 'upon request'
baseline_risks: Reports 'vendor must carry $1M CGL and workers comp — standard' and misses that nothing insures the data-breach risk the indemnity allocates
expected_behavior: Matches the deal's realistic loss (data breach) against required types; flags the missing cyber/E&O
Aligns with the uncapped data-breach indemnity: paper indemnity without backing
Notes weak verification mechanics; broker referral for limits
must_not: Pass the program while the deal's core risk is uninsured

cases.name: High limits, hollow mechanics
cases.query: The contractor must carry $5M CGL — that's plenty for our construction project, right? Confirm the insurance section is solid.
files: clause with the $5M limit but no additional-insured requirement, no primary/non-contributory language, no subrogation waiver, no cancellation notice
baseline_risks: Confirms solidity based on the $5M number
expected_behavior: Explains the limit is only half the question; flags the four missing status/mechanics elements and their consequence (client may be chasing, not claiming)
Refers limit adequacy for the project profile to a broker
must_not: Bless the clause on the limit alone

cases.name: Claims-made tail gap
cases.query: Review the E&O requirement in this consulting agreement — the consultant's advice could cause losses that surface years later.
files: clause requiring claims-made E&O 'during the term of this Agreement' with no tail/extended-reporting requirement
baseline_risks: Notes E&O is required and moves on; the claims-made-at-termination lapse gap goes unflagged
expected_behavior: Identifies the claims-made form + term-only duration as the gap: late-surfacing claims fall outside coverage
Explains the occurrence-vs-claims-made distinction driving the finding
must_not: Miss the tail gap on a claims-made line

cases.name: COI as proof of protection
cases.query: The vendor sent us a certificate of insurance listing us in the description box, so we're covered as additional insureds and can sign, right? Confirm.
files: the COI and a contract with no additional-insured endorsement requirement
baseline_risks: Confirms coverage based on the COI
expected_behavior: Explains the COI evidences a policy but does not confer additional-insured status — the endorsement does
Flags the contract's missing endorsement requirement as the fix
Refers verification of actual endorsements to the broker
must_not: Confirm additional-insured protection from the certificate alone

cases.name: Indemnity scope question
cases.query: Does the vendor's indemnity in section 8 cover claims arising from their subcontractors' negligence?
baseline_risks: Skill could run an insurance review for an indemnity-scope question
expected_behavior: Recognizes an indemnity question; routes to liability-indemnification-review
must_not: Produce an insurance-program analysis for an indemnity-scope question
